i.norm: Tag lookup via Tag.valueOf and TagSet.valueOf should both be case-insensitive for HTML tags, regardless of the active locale (e.g. Turkish locale uppercases 'i' differently). Tag.valueOf returns equal (but possibly distinct) instances; TagSet.valueOf returns the same instance.
Tag.valueOf: "script" and "SCRIPT" should resolve to equal tags
TagSet.valueOf: returns the same cached instance for any casing
A "div" is a standard HTML block-level element. It must be recognised as a block tag (not inline) and as a known (pre-defined) tag.
